label: Contracts: the loaded-contract classifier (front-loaded/back-loaded, max 5 per roster) now matches desktop Front Office and the Trade War Room exactly — a plain, unsuffixed one- or two-year extension no longer over-counts against the limit just because its frozen prior year differs from the new extension year(s), and the MYAC-loaded and loaded-extension gates refuse to proceed (instead of guessing) if the count can't be verified right now. Trade War Room: the loaded-contract limit is no longer silent when you're the one sending an offer. Building or reviewing an offer that would push your team (or a 3-way partner) over 5 loaded contracts now shows exactly who, the before/after count, and lets you pick which of your own loaded-contract players to drop before the offer can be sent -- on both mobile and desktop, for two-team and three-team trades alike. The picker shows the real players on your roster, never a guess. This is separate from the salary-cap acknowledgment and the structural-lineup check, which still work the same way they did.
